method: Current primary extracted bodies and bounded US provider results; no booking, browser task, firsthand visit or independent source replay

search.intent: Rooms query includes primary hotel, OTA listings and nearby-hotel directory; suite query includes OTA, family discussion/video, specialist guide and official FAQ. Two shared URLs do not establish one coherent new-URL job or two independent jobs.
search.materiality: UNKNOWN, not zero, low competition or proven demand. No hotel-to-activity transfer, summed variants, traffic forecast or unchanged failed toddler retry. No further modifier collection until a named coverage/change trigger.

sources.quality: Primary room and policy body; conceptual imagery, no category rates; policy changes and plan-specific conditions apply
Primary category capacities and admission rules; mixed current Now Open and future-tense/pre-opening text. No automatic whole-page freshness or firm-fit inference
Operator announcement and marketing, not independent review or exact November operating calendar

review_signals.next_gate: Dated independent category-matched online-review themes/conflicts before public family-fit judgments; no numeric representative rating

access_failures.unblock: Valid observed primary calendar URL and readable exact task dates
Valid observed primary ticket URL and permitted anonymous exact-date price body

source_conflicts: FAQ mixes Now Open with pre-opening wording and later-information language; access date cannot renew every statement
Hotel and FAQ support category capacity, not exact task booking acceptance, bunk/sofa comfort or measured rest return
General hotel cancellation terms cannot override a selected prepaid/nonrefundable plan

result.confidence: High in source attribution/category-policy distinctions; unknown demand, exact quote, calendar, guest comfort, actual acceptance and user/SEO outcomes
result.next_gate: Independent review and exact research-only release; then a changed numeric-demand or non-inferred material-demand record, exact category/party/date nightly-plus-admission/fees, valid task calendar and dated review conflicts. No repeated variants or calendar-only audit.
result.next_trigger: Published matched room/ticket costs, readable dated calendar, new reliable demand coverage or a concrete existing-page public defect; not another heartbeat or general opening announcement

gsc.limit: Page/property aggregates orientation only, no current Frisco query cohort or CTR diagnosis

registration_boundary: Scope-only keyword manifest created with registration helper before helper execution; action registered before any paid call or new task-evidence write. No retrospective action claim.
release_scope: Research/record regression only; all public/model/CSV/source-price records preserved; no new URL, quote renewal, review-body recovery, security bypass, account/contact/indexing/analytics/scheduler mutation
